capability.summary: Language model for multi-step analysis, coding, and document work.
capability.problem_space: Language model for multi-step analysis, coding, and document work. Applicable tasks include document synthesis, code generation, reasoning over supplied evidence, visual document interpretation. Accepts text, image input and produces text output. External tools are required to execute programs, browse sources, or modify files; generated instructions alone do not perform those actions.
